facts.business: Goyal Aluminiums Limited operates a manufacturing facility for aluminium products in Ballabgarh, Haryana.
facts.related_party_note: All transactions entered into by the Company with the Related Parties during the financial year were on arm's length basis and were in compliance with the requirements of provisions of Section 188 of the Act. The particulars of the Related Party Transactions are disclosed in Note No. 33 to the Financial Statements.
